prompt: Create a Python 3.12 order management application. Customers can have multiple orders. Each order belongs to exactly one customer and has a date and status. Provide CRUD operations for customers and orders and allow users to list all orders belonging to a customer.

intentions.text: I can create a new customer.
intentions.requires: a customer name and optional contact information
intentions.observable: the customer is added to the system and listed in the customer directory

intentions.text: I can retrieve a list of all customers.
intentions.observable: a list of all customers is displayed

intentions.text: I can create a new order for a customer.
intentions.requires: a customer identifier (e.g., name or ID), order date, and order status
intentions.observable: the order is created and appears in the list of orders for that customer

intentions.text: I can retrieve a list of all orders belonging to a specific customer.
intentions.requires: a customer identifier (e.g., name or ID)
intentions.observable: a list of orders for that customer is displayed, including order date and status

intentions.text: I can update the status of an existing order.
intentions.requires: an order identifier and a new status (e.g., 'pending', 'shipped')
intentions.observable: the order status is updated and reflected in the list of orders for that customer

intentions.text: I can delete an existing order.
intentions.observable: the order is removed from the list of orders for that customer

intentions.text: I can update a customer's information.
intentions.requires: a customer identifier and updated information (e.g., name, contact)
intentions.observable: the customer's details are updated and reflected in the list of customers
the customer is removed from the system and all associated orders are no longer linked to them
